Class GraphNetBuilder

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.graphnet.GraphNetBuilder
public final class GraphNetBuilder extends Object
Builds a drawable GraphPetriNet from a plain PetriNet and the coordinates that came with it.

Used whenever a net arrives without graphics of its own — imported from PNML, dropped on the canvas, or instantiated from a net library template.

Elements whose coordinates are missing are laid out on a fallback grid so that a net is always visible and draggable rather than piled up in one point.

      Builds a graph net keeping the shape described by the given coordinates.
      Parameters:
      net - the net to draw
      placeCoordinates - place number to position, may be empty
      transitionCoordinates - transition number to position, may be empty
      location - where to move the finished net's centre, or null to leave it where the coordinates put it

    • build

      public static GraphPetriNet build(PetriNet net, Map<Integer,Point2D.Double> placeCoordinates, Map<Integer,Point2D.Double> transitionCoordinates, Point location, boolean normalize)
      The variant that can keep coordinates exactly as given. Normalization to the (50,50) corner is a defense for foreign documents whose layouts may sit anywhere; for a document this application wrote itself, the coordinates are the user's own canvas positions, and normalizing them is precisely what made every reimported net drift and pile up.
      Parameters:
      normalize - false to trust the given coordinates as absolute canvas positions
